entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: And Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night which said, There is a man-child conceived.

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: Let that day be darkness; Let not God from above seek for it, Neither let the light shine upon it.

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let all that maketh black the day terrify it.

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it: Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: Lo, let that night be barren; Let no joyful voice come therein.

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark: Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning:

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother's] womb, Nor hid trouble from mine eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not give up the ghost when my mother bare me?

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should suck?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest,

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Who built up waste places for themselves;

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver:

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, As infants that never saw light.

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary are at rest.

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and the great are there: And the servant is free from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul;

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: Who long for death, but it cometh not, And dig for it more than for hid treasures;

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad, when they can find the grave?

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: [Why is light given] to a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my groanings are poured out like water.

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For the thing which I fear cometh upon me, And that which I am afraid of cometh unto me.

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; But trouble cometh.
